privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Vestya ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal data when you use our platform at vestya.net.
privacy.dataCollectedIntro: We collect the following personal data when you use Vestya:
privacy.dataCollectedDocuments: Documents you upload (deeds, contracts, invoices, photos)
privacy.howWeUseIntro: We use your data solely to provide and improve the Vestya service:
privacy.howWeUseService: Providing the core service — managing your properties, tasks, documents, and finances
privacy.howWeUseEmails: Sending transactional emails (invitations, notifications, password resets)
privacy.howWeUseSecurity: Maintaining the security and integrity of your account
privacy.dataStorageText: All data is stored within the European Union. We use Supabase (EU West region) for our PostgreSQL database and S3-compatible object storage for uploaded files. Your data never leaves the EU unless you explicitly choose to share it.
privacy.thirdPartiesIntro: We use a limited number of third-party services to operate Vestya:
privacy.thirdPartyNominatim: OpenStreetMap / Nominatim — geocoding for property addresses (no personal data is sent, only addresses)
privacy.retentionText: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. If you request deletion of your account, we will permanently remove all your personal data within 30 days. Backups containing your data are purged within 90 days of deletion.
privacy.yourRightsIntro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights:
privacy.rightAccess: Right of access — request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
privacy.rightRectification: Right to rectification — request correction of inaccurate data
privacy.rightErasure: Right to erasure — request deletion of your personal data
privacy.rightPortability: Right to data portability — receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
privacy.rightObjection: Right to object — object to the processing of your personal data
privacy.contactText: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, contact us at support@vestya.net.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.acceptanceText: By accessing or using Vestya (vestya.net), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our service.
terms.accountText: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You must provide accurate, current, and complete information during registration. You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorised use of your account.
terms.subscriptionText: Vestya offers subscription-based access to the platform. The following terms apply:
terms.subscriptionRenewal: Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing period unless cancelled before the renewal date.
terms.subscriptionCancellation: You may cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period.
terms.subscriptionRefund: Refunds are prorated based on the remaining time in your billing period. Refund requests can be made by contacting support@vestya.net.
terms.acceptableUseIntro: You agree not to use Vestya to:
terms.acceptableUseNoHarm: Upload or transmit any content that is unlawful, harmful, threatening, abusive, or otherwise objectionable
terms.acceptableUseNoUnauthorized: Attempt to gain unauthorised access to other accounts, systems, or networks
terms.acceptableUseNoIllegal: Use the service for any illegal purpose or in violation of any applicable laws
terms.acceptableUseNoAbuse: Abuse, interfere with, or disrupt the service or its infrastructure
terms.ipText: All content, features, and functionality of Vestya (including but not limited to text, graphics, logos, and software) are the exclusive property of Vestya and are protected by intellectual property laws. You retain ownership of all data and content you upload to the platform.
terms.liabilityText: Vestya is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, either express or implied. To the fullest extent permitted by law, Vestya shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including loss of profits, data, or use, arising out of or in connection with your use of the service.
terms.terminationText: We may suspend or terminate your account at any time if you violate these Terms of Service. Upon termination, your right to use the service will immediately cease. You may request export of your data within 30 days of termination.
terms.governingLawText: These Terms of Service are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales. Any disputes arising from these terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.
terms.contactText: If you have questions about these Terms of Service, contact us at support@vestya.net.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies Vestya (vestya.net) uses and how you can manage them.
cookies.essentialText: We use a session cookie set by NextAuth to keep you logged in. This cookie is strictly necessary for the service to function and cannot be disabled. It is deleted when you sign out or when your session expires.
cookies.functionalText: We use a locale preference cookie set by next-intl to remember your language choice (English or French). This ensures the interface is displayed in your preferred language on return visits.
cookies.analyticsText: We do not currently use any analytics or tracking cookies. If this changes in the future, we will update this policy and request your consent.
cookies.thirdPartyText: Vestya does not set any third-party tracking cookies. We do not use advertising networks or social media tracking pixels.
cookies.managingText: You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies. Please note that disabling essential cookies will prevent you from logging in to Vestya.
cookies.contactText: If you have questions about our use of cookies, contact us at support@vestya.net.

about.title: About Vestya
about.description: Vestya is a property management platform designed for families. We help families who own multiple homes bring order to the complexity of property management — from maintenance tasks and service contacts to documents, finances, and calendars.
about.missionText: Our mission is to simplify property management for families. Whether you own a holiday home, a rental flat, or a countryside estate, Vestya gives your family a single, secure place to coordinate everything. No more scattered spreadsheets, lost invoices, or forgotten maintenance schedules.
about.storyText: Vestya was founded in 2026 and is based in Exeter, United Kingdom. We built Vestya because we experienced first-hand how difficult it is to manage multiple family properties without a dedicated tool. We believe every family deserves a simple, private, and reliable way to look after their homes.
about.contactText: We would love to hear from you. Reach us at support@vestya.net or visit our contact page.
